scenarios.title: A｜发表意见
scenarios.setting: 团队正在讨论一个新方案，经理询问大家的想法。

turns.text: What do you think about this approach?

turns.prompt: 关于「开会讨论」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: I think it could work well.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think it could work well.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I like the idea, especially the second part.

feedback.naturalExpression: I like the idea, especially the second part.
feedback.explanation: “I like”直接分享喜好，后面说出具体类别，能给对方继续聊的话题。

choices.text: I think it’s worth trying.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think it’s worth trying.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: From my perspective, the simpler option might work better.

feedback.naturalExpression: From my perspective, the simpler option might work better.
feedback.explanation: “from my perspective”明确这是自己的看法，为不同意见留出讨论空间。

choices.text: I think this way is more better.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think it could work well.
feedback.explanation: “better”已是比较级，不与“more”连用；说“this way is better”即可。

turns.text: Why do you prefer the simpler option?

turns.prompt: 关于「开会讨论」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: I think it’ll be easier for users to understand.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think it’ll be easier for users to understand.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: It would take less time to implement.

feedback.naturalExpression: It would take less time to implement.
feedback.explanation: 用实现时间较短这一具体优势支持方案，便于团队比较。

choices.text: My main concern is that the other option might be too complicated.

feedback.naturalExpression: My main concern is that the other option might be too complicated.
feedback.explanation: “my main concern”指出自己最主要的顾虑，让讨论聚焦重点。

choices.text: I think we could get similar results with less work.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think we could get similar results with less work.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

turns.text: That’s a good point. Maybe we can simplify the original idea.

turns.prompt: 你想回应折中处理方案，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, I think that could be a good compromise.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I think that could be a good compromise.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: That makes sense to me.

feedback.naturalExpression: That makes sense to me.
feedback.explanation: 表示已经听懂或理解原因，给对方一个确认信号。

choices.text: I’d be happy to work on a simpler version first.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d be happy to work on a simpler version first.
feedback.explanation: “version”指版本，说明具体版本能避免双方使用不同文件。

scenarios.title: B｜询问问题
scenarios.setting: 在“开会讨论”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“询问问题”。

turns.text: We’ll test the new version with a small group of users next week.

turns.prompt: 你想确认计划参与测试的人数，会怎么说？

choices.text: How many users are we planning to test it with?

feedback.naturalExpression: How many users are we planning to test it with?
feedback.explanation: “How many”询问可数事物的数量，后面通常接复数名词。

choices.text: What exactly are we hoping to learn from the test?

feedback.naturalExpression: What exactly are we hoping to learn from the test?
feedback.explanation: “exactly”强调信息吻合或需要精确确认，适合核对具体细节。

choices.text: How will we collect their feedback?

feedback.naturalExpression: How will we collect their feedback?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Who’s going to be responsible for the testing?

feedback.naturalExpression: Who’s going to be responsible for the testing?
feedback.explanation: “responsible for”表示负责某项工作，能用来确认任务归属。

choices.text: How many users we will test?

feedback.naturalExpression: How many users are we planning to test it with?
feedback.explanation: 直接提问需要疑问语序：将“can / should / will”等放在主语前；若使用实义动词，则根据时态补上“do / does / did”。

turns.text: Around twenty. We’re mainly looking at whether people understand the new interface.

turns.prompt: 你想确认测试结果应如何比较和评价，会怎么说？

choices.text: Will we compare the results with the current version?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will we compare the results with the current version?
feedback.explanation: “version”指版本，说明具体版本能避免双方使用不同文件。

choices.text: What would count as a successful result?

feedback.naturalExpression: What would count as a successful result?
feedback.explanation: 用“What”明确提出所缺的信息，请对方补充说明，而不是让对方猜自己哪里没听懂。

choices.text: Are we testing anything besides the interface?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are we testing anything besides the interface?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

turns.text: For now, let’s just focus on the interface.

turns.prompt: 你想回应刚才的提议，确认接受或愿意配合，会怎么说？

choices.text: Got it. That answers my question.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. That answers my question.
feedback.explanation: 表示已经听懂或理解原因，给对方一个确认信号。

choices.text: Okay, thanks for clarifying.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, thanks for clarifying.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

scenarios.title: C｜表达不同意见
scenarios.setting: 在“开会讨论”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“表达不同意见”。

turns.text: I think we should launch the new version as soon as possible.

turns.prompt: 你想表达对立即推进的顾虑，建议进一步测试，会怎么说？

choices.text: I see your point, but I think we might need a little more testing first.

feedback.naturalExpression: I see your point, but I think we might need a little more testing first.
feedback.explanation: 先承认听懂了对方，再提出自己的顾虑；理解对方的理由并不等于完全同意。

choices.text: I’m not sure I completely agree. I think there are still a few issues we need to address.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure I completely agree. I think there are still a few issues we need to address.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: That’s one option, but I’d prefer to fix the main problems before we launch.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s one option, but I’d prefer to fix the main problems before we launch.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: I understand the reasoning, but I’m a little concerned about launching too early.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand the reasoning, but I’m a little concerned about launching too early.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: No, I think you’re wrong.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I see your point, but I think we might need a little more testing first.
feedback.explanation: 直接说对方错了可能使讨论转向防御；说明自己的不同判断及依据，更有助于比较方案。

turns.text: I’m worried that more testing will delay the launch.

turns.prompt: 关于「开会讨论」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: That’s true. Maybe we could test only the most important parts.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s true. Maybe we could test only the most important parts.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: What if we did a shorter round of testing instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: What if we did a shorter round of testing instead?
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

choices.text: I agree that timing matters. I just don’t want us to miss any major problems.

feedback.naturalExpression: I agree that timing matters. I just don’t want us to miss any major problems.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: Could we set a deadline for testing and then make a decision?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could we set a deadline for testing and then make a decision?
feedback.explanation: “deadline”指截止期限，指最晚需要完成的时间。

turns.prompt: 你想回应刚才的提议，确认接受或愿意配合，会怎么说？

choices.text: That works for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: That works for me.
feedback.explanation: 明确表示接受刚提出的方案，让对方知道可以按这个安排继续。

choices.text: Yeah, I think that’s a good compromise.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I think that’s a good compromise.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Great. Then we can make the final decision based on the results.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Then we can make the final decision based on the results.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

scenarios.title: D｜视频会议沟通问题
scenarios.setting: 玩家正在参加线上会议，但声音开始断断续续。

turns.text: So if we move the deadline to— [audio cuts out]

turns.prompt: 你想确认听到的信息，会怎样请对方重复或拼写？

choices.text: Sorry, you cut out for a second. Could you say that again?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, you cut out for a second. Could you say that again?
feedback.explanation: “cut out”在通话中表示声音断续或中断；是在描述连接问题，而不是评价对方的嗓音。

choices.text: Sorry, I missed the last part. Could you repeat it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, I missed the last part. Could you repeat it?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Your audio is breaking up a little.

feedback.naturalExpression: Your audio is breaking up a little.
feedback.explanation: “breaking up”在通话中表示声音断续或中断；是在描述连接问题，而不是评价对方的嗓音。

choices.text: I can hear you, but the connection isn’t very clear.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can hear you, but the connection isn’t very clear.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Your voice is broken.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, you cut out for a second. Could you say that again?
feedback.explanation: 通话声音断续常用“You’re breaking up / You cut out”；“Your voice is broken”容易被理解成嗓音本身有问题。

turns.prompt: 你想反馈会议通话是否恢复清晰，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, much better.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, much better.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Yes, I can hear you clearly now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I can hear you clearly now.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: A little better, but it’s still cutting out occasionally.

feedback.naturalExpression: A little better, but it’s still cutting out occasionally.
feedback.explanation: “cutting out”在通话中表示声音断续或中断；是在描述连接问题，而不是评价对方的嗓音。

turns.text: Alex, did you want to add something?

turns.prompt: 你想为刚才的情况致歉或作些说明，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sorry, I was on mute.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, I was on mute.
feedback.explanation: “on mute”表示麦克风处于静音状态，指出这一点能让对方直接检查设置。

choices.text: Sorry, I didn’t realize my microphone was muted.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, I didn’t realize my microphone was muted.
feedback.explanation: “muted”表示麦克风处于静音状态，指出这一点能让对方直接检查设置。

choices.text: Yeah, sorry. Can you hear me now?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, sorry. Can you hear me now?
feedback.explanation: “Can you …?”直接请对方帮忙，是常见口语请求；使用“can”本身并不等于不礼貌。

turns.prompt: 关于「开会讨论」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Great. What I wanted to say was…

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. What I wanted to say was…
feedback.explanation: “I wanted to”在提出请求或话题时常用于缓和语气，不一定只指过去的愿望。

choices.text: Perfect. I just wanted to add one thing.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I just wanted to add one thing.
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。
